trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum. It pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Follow this guide's roadmap in order and it will be the last trophy you unlock. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for the name, description and grade.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first mission of the game, so this is unmissable and unlocks as the story begins. It is the game's way of teaching the basic controls and the fishing mechanic. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; GTA Wiki for the mission's place in the story.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through every mission in Chapter 1 to its end. Chapter trophies cannot be missed — just keep following the story missions until the chapter closes. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; GTA Wiki for the chapter structure.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play through every mission in Chapter 2 to its end. Like the other chapter trophies it is unmissable — it unlocks when the chapter's final mission is done. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; GTA Wiki for the chapter structure.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Play through every mission in Chapter 3 to its end. Unmissable — it pops when the chapter's final mission is complete. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; GTA Wiki for the chapter structure.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Play through every mission in Chapter 4 to its end. Unmissable — it pops when the chapter's final mission is complete. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; GTA Wiki for the chapter structure.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the game's final mission. This is the story's ending, so it is unmissable — but note that some missable trophies are tied to choices made in the final stretch, so check the Missables tab before you start the finale. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; PowerPyx for the mission's place at the end of the story.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies are unmissable — finish the mission and the trophy pops. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; GTA Wiki for the mission's place in the story.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are unmissable — finish the job and the trophy pops. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; PowerPyx for the heist's place in the story.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Mission trophies are unmissable — finish the mission and the trophy pops. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; GTA Wiki for the mission's place in the story.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Mission trophies are unmissable — finish the mission and the trophy pops. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; GTA Wiki for the mission's place in the story.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. Mission trophies are unmissable — finish the mission and the trophy pops. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; PowerPyx for the mission's place in the story.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Mission trophies are unmissable — finish the mission and the trophy pops. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; GTA Wiki for the mission's place in the story.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game stats screen. That means every story mission, every side strand, every activity type and every collectible set the game counts — use this guide's checklist as your completion list and clear the remaining categories in the roadmap's later stages. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; GTA Wiki for what counts toward 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — the game's stunt jumps, airtime and trick challenges, tracked by PSN's counter. It is a long grind, so chip away at stunts between story missions rather than leaving all 250 for the end; every stunt you land counts toward the total. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing and the 250 count; PowerPyx for stunt locations.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once — fishing, racing, the shooting range, drone races, arcade games, meditation, hunting, stunts and the Top Fun events. You only need one attempt at each, not a win, so sample everything early and this pops fast. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing and the 9-type count; GTA Wiki for the activity list.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Gold needs accuracy and speed, so learn each range's layout, use a steady aim and replay the ones you silver until they turn gold — the counter tracks each challenge separately. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing and the 42-challenge count; PowerPyx for range tips.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location is a separate race, so you need a win at every one — learn the gates and the fastest line, and do not leave a location until you have its win. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing and the 14-location count; GTA Wiki for the race locations.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race only counts once, so you need 20 distinct events, not 20 wins of the same one. Work through the race list and tick each off; street, off-road and water races all count. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; PowerPyx for the race list.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head — match or beat Cal's catch by reeling steadily and not snapping the line. If you lose, challenge him again; it is not a one-time event. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; GTA Wiki for the fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any arcade game — just play one through to its end. The easiest is whichever arcade cabinet you find first; you do not need a high score, only a completion. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; GTA Wiki for the arcade locations.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's strand. Side-character strands unlock as you play the story — finish all of Andy's missions and the trophy pops with the last one. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; GTA Wiki for Andy's mission strand.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's strand. Finish all of Kenton's missions in order and the trophy pops with the last one. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; GTA Wiki for Kenton's mission strand.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's strand. Finish all of Billy's missions in order and the trophy pops with the last one. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; GTA Wiki for Billy's mission strand.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as icons on the map as you explore — there are more than 8 strands, so you can pick the ones you like, but finish 8 of them all the way through. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing and the 8-strand count; GTA Wiki for the stranger locations.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's strand. Finish all of Randy's missions in order and the trophy pops with the last one. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; GTA Wiki for Randy's mission strand.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's strand. Finish all of Tyrone's missions in order and the trophy pops with the last one. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; GTA Wiki for Tyrone's mission strand.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. The spots are scattered around the state — visit each one and meditate there; the counter tracks the spots you have used. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; GTA Wiki for the meditation spot locations.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting requests point you at a specific animal — track it, take the shot cleanly and bring it back. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; GTA Wiki for Bret's hunting requests.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — each set needs every card in it, so collect methodically and check the set lists in this guide's sources to see which cards you are missing. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing and the 3-set count; GTA Wiki for the card locations.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations — the game's photo/tag spots, one per location. It is a long collectible hunt, so do it as you travel: whenever you are near a new area, check for a WAiNK spot before you leave. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing and the 100-location count; GTA Wiki for the WAiNK spot map.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges — the game's challenge list spans driving, combat, exploration and more. Any 50 count, so pick the easiest ones first and let the harder ones come naturally as you play. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing and the 50-challenge count; PowerPyx for the challenge list.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — do this while your partner is with you. Build a 4-star wanted level with your partner in the vehicle, then lose the cops and escape. It needs your partner present, so do it during a mission or activity where you are together, before the story moves on. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; PowerPyx for the wanted-level method.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your Wanted Level. Plan a route through three shops, keep your partner close, and keep the heat on between robberies — if the wanted level drops, the chain breaks. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; PowerPyx for the shop-robbery route.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — get in and drive 100 distinct vehicle models. The counter tracks each model once, so try every new vehicle you see instead of sticking to one favourite. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing and the 100-vehicle count; GTA Wiki for the vehicle list.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus when a group of enemies is close together, then chain the takedowns before the effect ends — a crowded firefight is the best place to try it. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; PowerPyx for the Combat Focus method.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). Steal a plane and take off without a flight plan, before the airport's story moment passes. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; PowerPyx for the VCIA departure method.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — this one is tied to the Rhino tanks. Get into a Rhino and use it while the opportunity is open; the description's joke is the clue that it is a one-time vehicle moment. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; GTA Wiki for the Rhino's location.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, stay out of the cameras' and guards' sightlines, and leave before the alarm trips. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — reload and try again before the store's story moment passes. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; PowerPyx for the stealth approach.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Each vault is a separate job — crack it, grab the cash and get clear of the wanted level before it counts. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing and the 5-vault count; PowerPyx for the vault locations.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks patrol the roads — hit one, take the cash and lose the wanted level. If the first attempt goes wrong, another truck will come along. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; GTA Wiki for the armored truck routes.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — visit every named region of the state. Drive, fly and walk into each area until the map is filled in; the counter tracks regions, not miles. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; GTA Wiki for the region map.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang. Every gang runs its own operations around Leonida — hit one per gang and the trophy pops. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; GTA Wiki for the gang operation locations.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find the Ocean Beach bar spot and order a cocktail there while the moment is available — it is a quiet scene trophy, easy to walk past if you rush the story. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; GTA Wiki for the Ocean Beach spot.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through the showroom glass and out the other side while the showroom moment is open. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; PowerPyx for the showroom method.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Go bowling there and finish a game while the alley's story moment is available. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; GTA Wiki for the bowling alley.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — a partnership with mass appeal. This one is tied to a partnership moment with your partner — play it while the two of you are together and the opportunity is open. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; TrueTrophies for the partnership moment.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — choices made, for better or worse. This trophy is tied to a story choice: once you pick a path, the other one closes. Save before the big decisions so you can see both outcomes if you want. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; TrueTrophies for the choice point.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — second time's the charm. This one is tied to failing once and succeeding on the retry — a second attempt at a moment that only comes around once. If you pass it first try, the trophy may not pop, so watch for the moment and be ready. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; TrueTrophies for the retry moment.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A secret moment — something strange happens and the trophy pops. Keep an eye out for the odd, out-of-place event as you explore Leonida; it is the game's nod to the unexplained. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; GTA Wiki for the secret event.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — bowl them over with a melee drive-by. Drive past a group and swing a melee weapon from the vehicle to knock them down like pins. It needs a moving vehicle and a clear group, so set it up deliberately while the opportunity is open. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; PowerPyx for the drive-by method.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — launder them through your contacts over time and the total adds up. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing and the $250,000 target; GTA Wiki for the laundering contacts.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every purchase counts — clothes, weapons, vehicles, food — so it adds up naturally as you play; if you are close, buy a big-ticket item to finish it. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing and the $100,000 target; GTA Wiki for the shop list.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Garages are bought around Leonida — each one you own counts, and you need every one of them. Save up and buy them as they appear. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing; GTA Wiki for the garage property list.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find a vehicle, open the app and register it — ten distinct vehicles and the trophy pops. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official listing and the 10-vehicle count; GTA Wiki for the Scooter Bros app.
